name: May Smith (Dolan)
sources: Ancestry.com, Washington, U.S., Marriage Records, 1854-2013 (Robert Joseph Dolan and Marrion P. Hinds, Vancouver, Clark County, 9 Jun 1937)
Find a Grave, memorial 45057978 (May Smith Dolan, Mount Calvary Cemetery, Portland)
Ancestry.com, public member tree of Ed Simons (tree 189265374)
notes: Mother of Sheldon Joseph Dolan, named as May Dolan on his 1937 marriage record. Born 3 Jan 1886 at Hardman, Morrow County, Oregon; married Joseph Martin Dolan in 1906; died 15 Jan 1915 in Portland, aged 29, and was buried at Mount Calvary Cemetery; her children were Sheldon (1909) and Marjorie (1911–1996) (Find a Grave).

UNPROVEN, from the Find a Grave biography: daughter of Thomas Smith and Nellie Frances Hampton, who married on 24 Dec 1877 in Linn County, Oregon. Her sisters were Bertha Iona (1878–1968), Alice Leona (Tennent, 1882–1972) and Mary Delpha (Parker, 1888–1970).
Ed Simons's tree gives her full name as Mae Idilla Smith.
